title: Ridiculously easy to assemble
text:
Ridiculously easy to assemble. The shelves look better than I thought they might, and they are the perfect size for where I had wanted to place the unit. Like any lightweight shelving, make sure to anchor it with heavier items on the bottom two shelves, otherwise it has potential to be pushed over accidentally. I think each shelf can support a fair bit of weight (I am using it for indoor plants) but be mindful not to overdo it as the material the boards are made with might not support extra weight over time.

The shelves themselves are wood, I would guess to be a cheaper composite with laminate overlay. The side pillars which uphold each shelf are black plastic. This was not constructed to last through generations, but has the potential to last a long time if cared for properly. Also, assembling this was super simple and did not require any manuals or tools.
